theorems.name: Submission.constancy_riesz_eq_integral_mul_of_indicator_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α), IsFiniteMeasure μ → ∀ (F : (α → ℝ) → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ f g : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → F (f + g) = F f + F g) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ), Integrable f μ → F (c • f) = c * F f) → (∀ f : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → |F f| ≤ C * ∫ x, |f x| ∂μ) → ∀ (θ : α → ℝ) (M : ℝ), Measurable θ → (∀ x, |θ x| ≤ M) → (∀ A : Set α, MeasurableSet A → F (A.indicator 1) = ∫ x in A, θ x ∂μ) → ∀ f : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → F f = ∫ x, f x * θ x ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
